title: Product Specification - AI Clinical Front Door
summary: Decision-support prototype for supervised intake, urgency screening, care-pathway selection, next-information ranking, and auditable evidence tracking for clinical workflows.
notes: Hybrid PRD+SPEC: primary signals are product requirements (product statement, users, jobs-to-be-done, core screens, release stages); secondary SPEC signals (architecture diagram, non-functional requirements, contract reference). Classified as PRD due to dominant product/user-facing perspective and feature-specification focus.
